rows.basis: CLAUDE.md 'The declared CPU': cpuid is the reference host's answer (CPUREF, lift/rt/cpumodel.c) restricted to MMX, SSE, SSE2; SDM vol. 2A CPUID: the instruction returns the processor identification in EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX
CLAUDE.md 'One fixed reference CPU model': rdtsc reads the platform's monotonic timer (fnvl_rdtsc); SDM vol. 2B RDTSC: the 64-bit time-stamp counter is returned in EDX:EAX

facts.name: cpl
facts.source: CLAUDE.md 'The declared machine': the game is a Windows (Wine 9.0) user process
facts.basis: Windows user mode runs at CPL 3 (SDM vol. 3A 5.5 privilege levels)

facts.name: iopl
facts.source: CLAUDE.md 'The declared machine': EFLAGS.IOPL of an NT user process
facts.basis: Windows (and Wine 9.0) user threads run with EFLAGS.IOPL = 0

facts.name: io_bitmap_grants
facts.basis: an NT user process has an empty I/O permission bitmap: every port is denied at CPL 3 > IOPL
